summary: My project 'Abandoned but not forgotten' highly focuses on spacecrafts that helped us explore our solar system and then became silent heroes.
details: My project tells us about rovers and spacecrafts.it works as a sliding project.its gives knowledge about spacecrafts that went silent.i used canva,and the official NASA's data of the spacecrafts.my project is creative because it is completely made out of scratch and tries to cover everything that happened during the mission and why was the mission.these questions are included in my project and my project was completely made by a single person.
